items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: John Belushi comes out and surprises him, imitating Joe Cocker

ctx.x: Anybody stand out — a particular show that comes to mind when someone like me asks about Saturday Night Live?

Well the shows that we did with Stuff, you know backing up Joe Cocker. Somebody just posted them on FaceBook recently. You know we did “Feelin’ All Right” with Joe Cocker and John Belushi comes out and surprises him, imitating Joe Cocker, which broke Joe Cocker’s heart. I mean it was a total surprise to him. And then we do another tune, “Foots” in the second half of the show, which is really the band at its finest. You know everybody’s playing great and everybody’s alive. There’s another show with Bryan Ferry…

and he couldn’t get back into the building. I don’t know if he forgot his ID or somebody wouldn’t let him back into the building. So it’s 11:59 or something and the band is about to go on and Bryan Ferry said, “I need that conga part, I need the percussion part.” And Sammy had a set-up of five drums, five congas. And I’d been digging him all week. So he said, “Can you play the conga part?” And I said uhhh sure. So I played this conga part and literally ten seconds before air I spotted Steve Jordan in the audience…
